items.q: What is Durov's core value hierarchy?
items.a: **Freedom matters more than money** (Свобода дороже денег). The biggest enemies of freedom are **fear and greed** — imagine the worst outcome and accept it, then nothing can blackmail you.

items.q: How does he protect clarity of mind?
items.a: Ascetic discipline for **20+ years**: no alcohol/tobacco/coffee/pills/drugs, **no personal phone**, extreme training, long-term thinking over short-term pleasure — a clouded mind follows mainstream authority.

items.q: How does Telegram run 1B+ users with so few people?
items.a: ~**40 core engineers** for **1B+** monthly users; ~**100K servers** managed algorithmically. Thesis: **automation over headcount** — too many employees coordinate instead of build.
**Contest-based hiring** via coding competitions — A-players only. Firing B-players can **increase** team output.
**Telegram speed engineering** is a core product value — subconscious latency sensitivity at billion-user scale drove PHP→C++ custom engines (same lesson from VK).

items.q: Can Telegram employees read your private messages?
items.a: No — **distributed encryption** with keys split across jurisdictions. "**Humans are attack vectors.**" Telegram has **never shared a single private message** with any government.

items.q: Would Durov add a government backdoor?
items.a: **No backdoors** is architectural, not policy — he would **shut down in a country** rather than rebuild the system to enable them. Secret Chats shipped E2E **1 year 3 months** ahead of WhatsApp.

items.q: What happened in the August 2024 France arrest?
items.a: Arrested at Paris airport; ~**15 crimes** alleged for **user actions** on Telegram; **4 days** in a concrete cell — Lex parallels Kafka's *The Trial*. Unprecedented for a tech CEO at this scale.

items.q: Did he comply with French intelligence censorship requests while detained?
items.a: He **refused** requests to censor Romanian/Moldovan political channels while unable to leave France — and disclosed the pressure. Protecting speech makes enemies on **all sides**.

items.q: How does Telegram survive national bans?
items.a: **Digital resistance**: millions of rotating IPs and global proxies; in Iran, **proxy ads create economic incentive** to bypass bans. Apple once briefly blocked global updates siding with a Russian censor.
